triage.summary: Olivia Brown at Brown Bakery wants to automate their cake order form so orders are saved in a Google Sheet and asks for pricing.

task.title: Quote cake order form automation for Olivia Brown
task.description: Olivia Brown (olivia@brownbakery.com) asks whether you can automate Brown Bakery's cake order form to send orders to a Google Sheet and what it would cost. Ask for the form link and platform details to assess the work and provide a quote.

reply.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for reaching out! Could you send me a link to your cake order form and let me know what platform it uses? I’ll review the setup so I can give you a quote for sending orders to a Google Sheet.

Best,
Alex
